skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and respond to simple conversations and dialogues on various topics.
Communicate effectively in simple conversations and provide basic instructions and advice.
Read and understand short texts and articles on common topics.
Write short emails and paragraphs on familiar topics.
Apply basic French grammar rules and vocabulary.
Expand vocabulary related to daily life, health, sports, and social activities.
Develop independent learning skills through online resources and self-study.
Analyze and interpret texts and conversations on common topics.
